description: Look up research organizations in ROR, the open registry of universities, funders, hospitals, labs and companies worldwide. Search by name with filters for type, country and founding year, get an organization by its ROR ID, match an affiliation as an author wrote it to the right organization, find one from an email address or website, turn GRID, ISNI, Wikidata and Crossref Funder IDs into ROR IDs, and list an organization's parent and child organizations. No account or API key required.
